kernel.title: Core
kernel.mapHint: Value accepts a string or a YAML list, for example [223.5.5.5, 119.29.29.29].
kernel.scope: Only edited fields are saved. Configuration is validated before reloading the core. Save restored inheritance to refresh effective values. Enabling DNS, TUN or sniffing fills suggested settings absent from the profile.
kernel.modelSynced: Model synced; restart the Smart core to load it
kernel.smartHint: Only Smart-capable cores use this model. Sync writes Model.bin in the data directory. Save URL edits; restart the core to load the model.

hints.cache: Persist Fake-IP mappings to preserve applications using cached addresses after restart. Global UA identifies the core when downloading databases and subscriptions; leave blank to inherit the profile.
hints.ports: 0 disables a port. Redir is unavailable on Windows; TProxy is Linux only. Disable random ports before editing fixed ports.
hints.quic: QUIC blocking targets UDP 443. Foreign mode excludes CN and LAN addresses and requires GeoIP data. It applies in rule mode.
hints.nameservers: Default resolves DoH/DoT server hostnames. Primary servers handle ordinary queries; fallback servers are used when results match fallback filters.
hints.specialDns: Resolve proxy server hostnames and direct endpoints separately.
hints.fallback: Control when fallback DNS is used. With GeoIP enabled, results outside the configured country trigger fallback.
hints.tunRouting: Auto route configures system routes. Strict route prevents leaks but may affect inbound LAN services. Endpoint independent NAT helps some P2P games.
hints.darwin: RecvMsgX can reduce CPU usage during fast receives. SendMsgX is disabled by default to avoid stalls in some core versions during multithreaded downloads.
hints.hijack: Intercept DNS requests matching these targets and send them to the core DNS engine. Existing TUN behavior also enables DNS.
hints.excludeRoute: Traffic matching these CIDRs bypasses TUN and routes through physical interfaces.
hints.interfaceFilter: Limit the physical interfaces handled by TUN or exclude specific interfaces.
hints.portFilter: Bypass TUN for these source or destination ports, useful for discovery and some games.
hints.includeRoute: Restrict TUN routes to these ranges. Actual routing also depends on auto route, exclusions and the core version.
hints.sniffStatus: Extract hostnames from IP traffic so domain routing rules can apply.
hints.sniffBehavior: Override destinations with sniffed hostnames. Force DNS mapping and parse pure IP control which traffic is sniffed.
hints.sniffPorts: Set sniffing ports and destination overrides per protocol. Individual ports and ranges such as 8080-8880 are supported.
hints.forceSniff: Force sniffing and destination overrides for these domains.
hints.skipSniff: Skip these domains or addresses. Apple push and some IoT services validate destination hostnames; overrides may break connections.
